question: Do ALQSSWGMMG78/LQSSWGMMGM67/QSSWGMMGML56 author windows target the same assay bond?
answer: Yes. Author code defines the two suffix digits as local P1/P1prime; all three exact sequence windows map those residues to assay G7/M8. The absolute mapping is arithmetic, not a guessed filename convention.

window_mappings.alignment_status: unique exact substring; absolute positions are our deterministic arithmetic from author-defined local positions
window_mappings.analogue_correspondence: One pts modification at local P1 represents the original local P1/P1prime pair; residues downstream of P1prime shift down by one in the modified chain.
